business_summary: TOYO Corporation provides measurement solutions in Japan. The company provides advanced measurement technologies for energy; equipment and solutions for measurement, analysis, and experimental data management to support research and development of transportation equipment such as automobiles and trains, as well as noise and vibration, and safety and durability of industrial machinery; and standard compliance testing services and solutions. It also offers test systems and analysis/monitoring systems; software development lifecycle products and services; and electromagnetic compatibility compliance testing and over the air measurement systems for 5G and connected vehicles, as well as installs, support, and maintains large parabolic antenna ground systems. In addition, the company provides ocean survey and measurement equipment for offshore, underwater, and submarine applications, as well as port areas; measurement technologies to cyber security products and services; and medical imaging solutions, including interpretation support systems for chest X-ray and CT images, and 2D and 3D preoperative digital planning tools in orthopedic surgery. Further, it develops customized products and autonomous driving/advanced driver assistance system. The company was formerly known as TOYO Trading Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TOYO Corporation in February 1977. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
